messages.使うたびに弦驚から大龍へ強化され、呼吸で伸びる傲慢斬撃の広域E.G.O。: A multi-target Pride Slash E.G.O that upgrades from Thunderer to Higher Thunderer with each use and grows with Poise.
messages.弦驚と大龍: 攻撃後に弦驚5を得て、弦驚か大龍があれば大龍5に切り替わる。どちら: **Thunderer and Higher Thunderer**: After the attack, he gains 5 Thunderer, and if he already has Thunderer or Higher Thunderer, it switches to 5 Higher Thunderer. Both raise Offense and Defense Level and decrease by 1 at Turn End. Damage rises depending on which he has (Thunderer 15%, Higher Thunderer 27%; 25% and 45% at Threadspin Ⅳ). From Threadspin Ⅲ, Attack Weight also increases: 4 on the first use, 5 with Thunderer, and 6 with Higher Thunderer.
messages.初回の返還(解析Ⅳ): 弦驚も大龍もない初回は、消耗した資源と精神力の半分が戻る: **First-use refund (Threadspin Ⅳ)**: On the first use, with neither Thunderer nor Higher Thunderer, half of the resources and SP spent are returned.
messages.呼吸: 使用時に呼吸威力を得る。呼吸が溜まるほど最終威力が上がる(解析Ⅳは最大+: **Poise**: Gains Poise Potency on use. The more Poise he has, the higher the Final Power (up to +3 at Threadspin Ⅳ). It does not increase Poise Count, so Poise Identities should be careful not to run out.
messages.パッシブ「酔吟の興、ここに極まれり」: ターン終了時に、必要資源のうち最も少ない: **Passive — So is Writ, an Ode to Wine**: At Turn End, he gains 1 of the required resource he has the least of. Damage also increases when Thunderer or Higher Thunderer decreases or is consumed, up to 15%.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 破壊不能コインの3コイン。弦驚か大龍があると大きく強化されるので、: **Corrosion skill**: 3 Unbreakable Coins. It is greatly strengthened while he has Thunderer or Higher Thunderer, so it shines from the second use onward.
messages.初回は低コストで撃ち、必要なら連続で大龍まで進める。: Fire the first use at low cost, and if needed, use it consecutively to advance to Higher Thunderer.
messages.呼吸を持つ人格で使い、クリティカルダメージの上乗せも狙う。: Use it with an Identity that has Poise, also aiming for extra Critical damage.
messages.資源は怠惰1・憂鬱2・傲慢4で、傲慢に偏る。: Its resources are 1 Sloth, 2 Gloom, and 4 Pride, skewed toward Pride.
messages.Ⅱ: パッシブが解放され、資源を自力で補える。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks the passive, letting him replenish resources on his own.
messages.Ⅲ: 弦驚・大龍による加重値増加が入り、2回目以降の加重値が5・6になる。: **Ⅲ**: Adds the Attack Weight increase from Thunderer and Higher Thunderer, making Attack Weight 5 and 6 from the second use on.
messages.Ⅳ: 初回の返還、ダメージ量増加の強化、呼吸による最終威力の上限引き上げが入る。: **Ⅳ**: Adds the first-use refund, a stronger damage increase, and a higher cap on Poise-based Final Power.
messages.終止符事務所代表: S1(怠惰)・S2(憂鬱)・S3(傲慢)で必要資源の3属性を: **[Full-Stop Office Rep](persona:0611)**: S1 (Sloth), S2 (Gloom), and S3 (Pride) supply all three required affinities, and S1 and S3 gain Poise.
messages.東部センク協会3課: S1(憂鬱)が呼吸回数を3増やし、S3(傲慢)も呼吸を得る: **[Cinq Assoc. East Section 3](persona:0616)**: S1 (Gloom) increases Poise Count by 3, and S3 (Pride) also gains Poise, making it easy to avoid running out of Poise Count.
